title: Sun Mahadasha (6 years)
text: The Sun's period emphasises authority, career advancement, recognition and dealings with government or father-figures. It favours leadership and self-assertion; health of the eyes, heart and bones, and relations with superiors, come to the fore. Results depend greatly on the Sun's strength and placement in the chart.

title: Moon Mahadasha (10 years)
text: The Moon's period highlights the mind, emotions, home, mother and public life. A well-placed Moon brings comfort, popularity, travel and emotional fulfilment; a weak Moon can bring mood swings and instability. Matters of the heart and family are prominent.

title: Mars Mahadasha (7 years)
text: The Mars period brings energy, drive, courage and action — favouring property, engineering, competition and bold initiatives. It can also bring conflict, haste, accidents or disputes if Mars is afflicted. Siblings and land matters often feature.

title: Mercury Mahadasha (17 years)
text: The Mercury period favours education, communication, commerce, writing and intellectual pursuits. It supports learning, business expansion, travel and skilful negotiation. A strong Mercury brings prosperity through intellect; an afflicted one, nervousness or scattered focus.

title: Jupiter Mahadasha (16 years)
text: The Jupiter period is generally the most auspicious, bringing wisdom, growth, prosperity, children, higher learning and spiritual progress. It favours teaching, counsel, marriage and expansion of fortune. A strong Jupiter makes this a landmark period of good fortune.

title: Venus Mahadasha (20 years)
text: The Venus period, the longest, emphasises love, marriage, comforts, art, wealth and pleasure. It favours relationships, creativity, luxury and material gains. A well-placed Venus makes this a time of enjoyment and refinement; an afflicted one, indulgence or relationship turbulence.

title: Saturn Mahadasha (19 years)
text: The Saturn period tests through discipline, responsibility, delay and hard work, but rewards perseverance with durable achievement. It can bring career consolidation, maturity and detachment, alongside challenges, loss or restriction that build lasting strength. Results depend heavily on Saturn's condition.

title: Rahu Mahadasha (18 years)
text: The Rahu period brings worldly ambition, sudden changes, foreign connections and unconventional paths. It can elevate the native rapidly or create confusion and obsession, depending on placement. Material gain, technology, travel abroad and bold risk-taking are common themes.

title: Ketu Mahadasha (7 years)
text: The Ketu period turns attention inward, bringing detachment, spiritual seeking, and sometimes sudden endings or losses that clear the way for growth. It favours research, mysticism and letting go of what no longer serves, though material affairs may feel uncertain.

title: Moon in Ashwini
text: Ashwini, ruled by Ketu and the Ashwini Kumaras (celestial healers), gives a pioneering, energetic and quick-acting nature. The native heals, initiates and moves fast, loves independence and travel, but can be impulsive and impatient.

title: Moon in Bharani
text: Bharani, ruled by Venus and the deity Yama, gives strong will, endurance and a capacity to bear burdens and transform. The native is determined and creative, with powerful desires that benefit from discipline.

title: Moon in Krittika
text: Krittika, ruled by the Sun and the fire-deity Agni, gives sharpness, courage and a cutting, purifying intellect. The native is ambitious and protective, with a fiery drive to achieve and a taste for recognition.

title: Moon in Rohini
text: Rohini, ruled by the Moon and the deity Brahma, is counted among the most favourable birth stars. It gives charm, beauty, artistic talent, material prosperity and a magnetic, sensual nature, though attachment to comfort is a theme.

title: Moon in Mrigashira
text: Mrigashira, ruled by Mars and the deity Soma, gives a curious, searching and gentle nature. The native is a seeker — of knowledge, experience or the ideal — often restless, communicative and fond of exploration.

title: Moon in Ardra
text: Ardra, ruled by Rahu and the storm-deity Rudra, gives intensity, intellectual depth and the power to break down and rebuild. The native can be emotionally turbulent but transformative, probing and determined to get to the truth.

title: Moon in Punarvasu
text: Punarvasu, ruled by Jupiter and the deity Aditi, gives optimism, resilience and the ability to renew and recover. The native is philosophical, generous and adaptable, finding safety and return after every setback.

title: Moon in Pushya
text: Pushya, ruled by Saturn and the priest-deity Brihaspati, is regarded as the most nourishing and auspicious nakshatra. It gives caring, dutiful and spiritually inclined qualities, stability, and the ability to support and provide for others.

title: Moon in Ashlesha
text: Ashlesha, ruled by Mercury and the Nagas (serpent deities), gives penetrating insight, strategic intelligence and hypnotic charm. The native is perceptive and persuasive, with a gift for understanding hidden motives; detachment guards against possessiveness.

title: Moon in Magha
text: Magha, ruled by Ketu and the Pitris (ancestors), gives dignity, pride in heritage and a regal, authoritative bearing. The native honours tradition and lineage, seeks respect and position, and carries a sense of noble responsibility.

title: Moon in Purva Phalguni
text: Purva Phalguni, ruled by Venus and the deity Bhaga, gives warmth, creativity and a love of pleasure, leisure and the arts. The native is generous, sociable and romantic, enjoying life's comforts and bringing joy to others.

title: Moon in Uttara Phalguni
text: Uttara Phalguni, ruled by the Sun and the deity Aryaman, gives generosity, reliability and a talent for friendship, partnership and service. The native balances kindness with ambition and is valued for loyalty and helpfulness.

title: Moon in Hasta
text: Hasta, ruled by the Moon and the Sun-deity Savitar, gives skill with the hands, cleverness and resourcefulness. The native is industrious, dexterous and witty, able to craft and manifest, though attention to detail can tip into worry.

title: Moon in Chitra
text: Chitra, ruled by Mars and the celestial architect Vishwakarma, gives an eye for design, beauty and craftsmanship. The native is charismatic and creative, drawn to building things of lasting brilliance and to a striking personal style.

title: Moon in Swati
text: Swati, ruled by Rahu and the wind-deity Vayu, gives independence, adaptability and a love of freedom. The native is self-reliant, diplomatic and flexible, flourishing through trade, movement and the ability to go their own way.

title: Moon in Vishakha
text: Vishakha, ruled by Jupiter and the deities Indra and Agni, gives ambition, determination and goal-focused drive. The native pursues aims single-mindedly and achieves through persistence, balancing desire with purpose.

title: Moon in Anuradha
text: Anuradha, ruled by Saturn and the friendship-deity Mitra, gives devotion, loyalty and a talent for cooperation and lasting bonds. The native succeeds through friendship and organised group effort, often far from home, with steady emotional depth.

title: Moon in Jyeshtha
text: Jyeshtha, ruled by Mercury and the king-deity Indra, gives seniority, responsibility and protective authority. The native is capable and commanding, often carrying heavy duties, and benefits from humility amid their drive for status.

title: Moon in Mula
text: Mula, ruled by Ketu and the destruction-deity Nirriti, gives a probing, truth-seeking nature that gets to the root of things. The native is philosophical and investigative, often experiencing upheaval that ultimately frees them toward deeper understanding.

title: Moon in Purva Ashadha
text: Purva Ashadha, ruled by Venus and the water-deity Apas, gives conviction, ambition and invincible optimism. The native is persuasive and proud, with a rejuvenating influence on others and a drive toward recognition and improvement.

title: Moon in Uttara Ashadha
text: Uttara Ashadha, ruled by the Sun and the Vishwadevas (universal gods), gives integrity, leadership and lasting achievement. The native succeeds through righteous effort and perseverance, earning enduring respect rather than quick wins.

title: Moon in Shravana
text: Shravana, ruled by the Moon and the preserver Vishnu, gives a gift for listening, learning and connection. The native gathers knowledge and wisdom, is a good counsellor and communicator, and often rises through scholarship or reputation.

title: Moon in Dhanishta
text: Dhanishta, ruled by Mars and the eight Vasus, gives rhythm, wealth-building ability and musical or performative talent. The native is energetic, prosperous and generous, thriving in group endeavours and public life.

title: Moon in Shatabhisha
text: Shatabhisha, ruled by Rahu and the cosmic-waters deity Varuna, gives a healing, secretive and independent nature. The native is drawn to mysteries, medicine and technology, often unconventional and private, with a gift for solving hidden problems.

title: Moon in Purva Bhadrapada
text: Purva Bhadrapada, ruled by Jupiter and the fierce fire-deity Aja Ekapada, gives intensity, idealism and a willingness to sacrifice for a cause. The native is passionate and visionary, drawn to profound or spiritual pursuits, sometimes unconventional.

title: Moon in Uttara Bhadrapada
text: Uttara Bhadrapada, ruled by Saturn and the deep-sea serpent Ahir Budhnya, gives wisdom, depth and a calm, compassionate temperament. The native is patient and self-controlled, with strong spiritual grounding and the ability to bring peace amid turmoil.

title: Moon in Revati
text: Revati, ruled by Mercury and the deity Pushan (protector of travellers), gives gentleness, compassion and a nurturing, guiding spirit. The native is kind, artistic and spiritually inclined, a natural protector who helps others find their way.

title: Sun in the 1st house (Lagna)
text: The Sun in the ascendant gives a strong constitution, a commanding presence and self-confidence. The native is ambitious, somewhat impatient, and drawn to positions of leadership. Health concerns may centre on the eyes or the head, and ego can overshadow diplomacy.

title: Sun in the 4th house
text: The Sun in the fourth can unsettle domestic peace and one's relationship with the mother, and may indicate frequent change of residence. Property matters carry tension, yet the native often rises to a respected standing later in life.

title: Sun in the 7th house
text: The Sun in the seventh can strain partnership and marriage through pride or domination, and business partnerships require care. Ego friction with the spouse is a recurring theme that softens with maturity.

title: Sun in the 10th house
text: The Sun in the tenth is a classic placement for career success, authority and recognition. The native gains standing through government, administration or positions of command, and the reputation tends to grow over time. This is counted among the strongest positions for the Sun.

title: Moon in the 1st house
text: The Moon in the ascendant gives an emotional, receptive and imaginative nature. The native is sensitive to surroundings and moods, charming in company, and often good-looking. Emotional stability depends greatly on the Moon's waxing or waning state.

title: Moon in the 4th house
text: The Moon in the fourth, its natural house, brings emotional contentment at home, a close bond with the mother, and comforts such as property and vehicles. The mind finds peace in domestic life, and the later years are generally settled.

title: Moon in the 7th house
text: The Moon in the seventh favours an attractive, affectionate spouse and emotional closeness in marriage. The native values companionship highly and may be drawn to public-facing or people-centred work.

title: Moon in the 10th house
text: The Moon in the tenth supports a career connected to the public, nurturing fields, liquids, or changeable environments. Reputation fluctuates with circumstance, but adaptability and popularity aid professional progress.

title: Mars in the 1st house
text: Mars in the ascendant gives energy, courage, a competitive drive and physical strength. The native is bold and direct, but prone to anger, haste and accidents or scars. This is one component of the Manglik (Kuja dosha) consideration.

title: Mars in the 7th house
text: Mars in the seventh is a principal Manglik placement and can bring friction, impatience or conflict into marriage and partnerships. Energy in the relationship is high; conscious patience and a compatible partner greatly ease the effect.

title: Mars in the 10th house
text: Mars in the tenth is excellent for careers demanding drive, discipline and command — the military, engineering, surgery, sport or enterprise. It gives ambition and the capacity for sustained hard work, and is a form of directional strength (digbala) for Mars.

title: Mercury in the 1st house
text: Mercury in the ascendant gives intelligence, wit, a youthful appearance and skill with words and numbers. The native is communicative, analytical and adaptable, with an aptitude for learning, writing and commerce.

title: Mercury in the 10th house
text: Mercury in the tenth favours careers in communication, trade, writing, accounting, analysis and intellect-driven professions. The native prospers through skill, versatility and networking, and often holds more than one line of work.

title: Jupiter in the 1st house
text: Jupiter in the ascendant is highly auspicious, giving wisdom, optimism, good ethics and a dignified presence. The native tends toward learning, teaching and spirituality, enjoys general good fortune, and is protected in difficulty. A form of directional strength for Jupiter.

title: Jupiter in the 5th house
text: Jupiter in the fifth blesses children, education, intelligence and creative or devotional pursuits. It gives sound judgement, success in teaching or advisory roles, and a virtuous, fortunate turn of mind.

title: Jupiter in the 9th house
text: Jupiter in the ninth, the house of fortune and dharma, is among the most auspicious placements. It gives faith, higher learning, long journeys, a philosophical outlook and the support of teachers and elders. Prosperity and good fortune are strongly indicated.

title: Venus in the 1st house
text: Venus in the ascendant gives beauty, charm, a pleasing manner and a love of comfort, art and refinement. The native is attractive to others, diplomatic and sociable, with good fortune in relationships and the arts.

title: Venus in the 7th house
text: Venus in the seventh, its natural house of relationship, favours a happy marriage, an attractive and loving partner, and harmony in partnerships. The native enjoys companionship, pleasure and often gains through marriage or joint ventures.

title: Saturn in the 1st house
text: Saturn in the ascendant gives a serious, disciplined and reserved nature, often with early hardships that build resilience. The native matures slowly but steadily, succeeds through patience and endurance, and tends to look older than their years.

title: Saturn in the 7th house
text: Saturn in the seventh can delay marriage but, once settled, often gives a stable, lasting and dutiful partnership, sometimes with an older or more mature partner. It rewards commitment and patience in relationships and business alike.

title: Saturn in the 10th house
text: Saturn in the tenth is a strong karmic placement for career, giving steady rise through sustained effort, responsibility and discipline. Success comes gradually but endures; the native is suited to administration, labour-related fields, law or long-term institutions. A form of directional strength for Saturn.

title: Rahu in the 1st house
text: Rahu in the ascendant gives an unconventional, ambitious and magnetic personality, often with an unusual appearance or outlook. The native is drawn to foreign things and worldly achievement, but should guard against restlessness, confusion of identity and over-reaching.

title: Ketu in the 1st house
text: Ketu in the ascendant gives a detached, introspective and spiritually inclined nature. The native may feel uncertain about identity or appearance, is drawn to the mystical, and benefits from inner work and letting go of material over-attachment.

title: Sun exalted in Aries
text: An exalted Sun gives powerful vitality, natural leadership, strong will and a noble, dignified character. Authority comes readily and the native commands respect. This is among the best possible placements for confidence and public standing.

title: Sun debilitated in Libra
text: A debilitated Sun can undermine confidence and self-worth, making the native dependent on others' approval or uneasy with authority. With supporting factors (a cancellation of debility, or benefic aspect) this softens, and humility can become a genuine strength.

title: Moon exalted in Taurus
text: An exalted Moon gives emotional stability, a calm and contented mind, popularity and material comfort. The native is nurturing, well-liked and emotionally secure, with a steady and generous disposition.

title: Moon debilitated in Scorpio
text: A debilitated Moon can bring emotional intensity, restlessness or a tendency to brood, with strong and sometimes turbulent feelings. Channelled well, it grants depth, resilience and transformative emotional insight.

title: Mars exalted in Capricorn
text: An exalted Mars gives disciplined courage, executive ability and the stamina to pursue long, demanding goals. Energy is well-directed rather than impulsive, making the native an effective leader, builder or strategist.

title: Mars debilitated in Cancer
text: A debilitated Mars can make energy and anger harder to direct — sometimes suppressed, sometimes reactive — and confidence may waver under pressure. Emotional security and a clear cause help the native focus this energy constructively.

title: Mercury exalted in Virgo
text: An exalted Mercury (also its own sign) gives sharp intellect, precise analysis, excellent communication and strong business sense. The native excels in study, writing, commerce and any field rewarding clarity and detail.

title: Jupiter exalted in Cancer
text: An exalted Jupiter gives wisdom, generosity, strong ethics, faith and abundant good fortune. The native is respected as a guide or benefactor, enjoys protection in adversity, and prospers through knowledge, teaching and benevolence.

title: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn
text: A debilitated Jupiter can make faith, optimism or generosity harder to access, and the native may be overly pragmatic or skeptical of guidance. Cultivating genuine principles and mentors restores Jupiter's blessings over time.

title: Venus exalted in Pisces
text: An exalted Venus gives refined artistic taste, deep capacity for love, grace and devotion, and good fortune in relationships and comforts. The native is compassionate, creative and often blessed with beauty and material ease.

title: Venus debilitated in Virgo
text: A debilitated Venus can make affection more analytical or reserved, and the native may set exacting standards in love or undervalue their own charm. Self-acceptance and warmth free Venus to express its natural grace.

title: Saturn exalted in Libra
text: An exalted Saturn gives justice, integrity, organisational mastery and the ability to build lasting structures. The native is fair, disciplined and respected for responsibility, often rising to positions of authority through sustained effort.

title: Saturn debilitated in Aries
text: A debilitated Saturn can bring impatience with discipline, fear of limitation, or a struggle between haste and caution. Learning steady, methodical effort turns this placement's early frustrations into hard-won competence.

title: Gajakesari Yoga
text: Gajakesari Yoga forms when Jupiter is in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th) from the Moon. It bestows intelligence, respect, lasting reputation, prosperity and a virtuous character. The native gains influence and is held in high esteem, the effect strengthening with the dignity of Jupiter and the Moon.

title: Budha-Aditya Yoga
text: Budha-Aditya Yoga forms when the Sun and Mercury are together in the same sign. It gives sharp intelligence, administrative ability, skill in communication and success in intellectual or governmental work. The native is clever, articulate and well-regarded for competence.

title: Chandra-Mangala Yoga
text: Chandra-Mangala Yoga forms when the Moon and Mars are conjunct. It is a classic wealth-generating combination, giving business acumen, drive and the ability to earn, though it can also bring emotional intensity or a hard-edged practicality in money matters.

title: Sade Sati — peak phase (Saturn over the Moon sign)
text: During the peak of Sade Sati, Saturn transits the natal Moon sign, pressing most directly on the mind and emotions. It is a demanding period of responsibility, introspection and often hard lessons, but one that builds maturity, realism and lasting strength when met with patience and discipline.

title: Sade Sati — rising phase (Saturn in the 12th from the Moon)
text: The rising phase of Sade Sati, with Saturn in the twelfth from the natal Moon, often brings increased expenses, detachment, and a winding-down of old commitments. It is a time to conserve resources, release what is finished, and prepare inwardly for the changes ahead.

title: Sade Sati — setting phase (Saturn in the 2nd from the Moon)
text: The setting phase of Sade Sati, with Saturn in the second from the natal Moon, concentrates on finances, family and speech. Responsibilities around money and dependents peak, but the hardest lessons ease, and disciplined effort now consolidates security for the future.

title: Favourable Jupiter transit
text: Jupiter transiting a supportive house from the natal Moon (notably the 2nd, 5th, 7, 9, or 11th) generally brings growth, opportunity, good fortune and expansion in the matters of that house — wealth, children, partnership, learning or gains. It is traditionally a welcome, auspicious transit.

title: Pancha Mahapurusha Yoga
text: A Pancha Mahapurusha Yoga forms when Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) while in its own sign or exaltation (Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya and Shasha respectively). It marks an exceptional, distinguished life, giving the qualities of that planet in abundance — courage, intellect, wisdom, charm or discipline.
